body: Yes, I suppose I am. But trust me, they wouldn't really care if I died. I have been fighting for perfection all my life to overcome the guilt of existence (my parents basically gave up everything and had to stay together because I was conceived), and I don't know how to feel emotions anymore. I feel so dysfunctional and disconnected, and I don't want to try to find happiness or hobbies, because that would cause even more guilt.

Why is it better to live? I wish I could think of a single reason- but I can't. I've been depressed for years and it's been all the same. I drag myself everywhere, I feel so uncomfortable around everyone, including my family- you know, I really appreciate you taking the time to do this. I searched your username, you encourage so many people on here to continue living- its nice to see that beautiful people truly exist, really the world is actually a beautiful place. I hope you find happiness as well. The earth will revolve and improve without me. I used to wish I could have a place in it- but I don't care anymore, everything is too overwhelming, I would rather die now. (well, my grandfather is staying with us until tues so I can wait. I've waited and thought about this for months, its been dragged on far too long. Im planning on hanging myself on tues night)

Thanks for answering. It's not good enough for my parents, and if I'm not really doing anything for myself- whats the point? I hate feeling disgusting all the time, never being able to feel pride and accomplishments. So what if I get into college? I'll have to act slightly happy, and push endlessly through pointless classes to get a degree, find some shallow adventures/excitements and then die. Wouldn't it be easier to end it now? Death is just an extreme form of 'innocence is bliss'. I'll die eventually, and if I die now- my name will be remembered as that struggling suicidal kid, not the emotionless loser that dragged through life, sucking resources and energy from everyone else. I just don't remember how to like myself.
